Bill.BriefDescription: Preventing storm water pollution from coal tar sealants.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to preventing storm water pollution from coal tarsealants; and adding a new chapter to Title 70 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The definitions in this section applythroughout this chapter unless the context clearly requires otherwise. (1) "Coal tar" means a material that contains coal tar identifiedby chemical abstract number 8007452. (2) "Coal tar pavement product" means a material that contains coaltar that is intended for use as a pavement sealant. (3) "Department" means the department of ecology.

(1) After January 1, 2012, no person maysell at wholesale or retail a coal tar pavement product that is labeledas containing coal tar. (2) After July 1, 2012, a person may not apply a coal tar pavementproduct on a driveway or parking area. (3) The department may issue a notice of corrective action to aperson in violation of subsection (1) or (2) of this section. p. 1 ESHB 1721 (4) A city or county may adopt an ordinance providing forenforcement of the requirements of subsection (1) or (2) of thissection. A city or county adopting an ordinance has jurisdictionconcurrent with the department to enforce this section.
Sections 1 and 2 of this act constitute anew chapter in Title 70 RCW.
